breaking_changes: The version scheme changed from M.m.p to YYYY.WW.N format; CMake version extraction moved to a Python-based git state derivation system, MSI installer versions are reformatted as YY.MM.PATCH, and the get-version action now outputs YYYY.WW.N instead of the static CMake VERSION.

evidence.blockers: Downstream package formats (Fedora, Debian, MSI, Snap, Docker) must be verified against the new YYYY.WW.N version scheme — the MSI version field cannot handle year > 255 without the YY.MM.PATCH reformatter. The new candidate pipeline (release-v* → candidate-v* tags, unsigned MSIs, prerelease publishing) has never been exercised end-to-end and must be validated before any real release-candidate testing.
evidence.breaking_changes: The version scheme is the sole breaking change. All downstream consumers (Fedora, Debian, MSI, Snap, Docker, macOS) ship under this scheme and require platform-specific verification. MSI reformats to YY.MM.PATCH to avoid version field overflow. The get-version action output changed format, and CMake VERSION is now derived dynamically from git state.
evidence.coverage: All 38 commit review(s) in the digest were used. The 19 to-dos from the continuity baseline were rated. Two commits in this range have no commit review and are not in the digest.
evidence.manual_testing: New user-facing endpoints and features need human verification: /v1/docs index and page fetch, the lemonade_docs MCP tool with a standard client, the FLM download path with ModelScope as default source, and JSON round-trip of source/registry_source fields. The candidate pipeline should be exercised on a release-v* branch before being relied upon.
evidence.security: No new security concerns observed in this release. The origin wildcard matching (6a5e307) maintains strict scheme enforcement and dot-boundary subdomain checks. The HF compatibility filter (6a60710) closes a download surface by rejecting incompatible repos. The MCP client revert (496bb24) removes an unshipped attack surface. No credential or supply-chain issues detected.
